scenes.heading: Building a review and reputation pipeline

sents.d: Building a review and reputation pipeline
For a local business, your review count and rating often matter more than your website.

scenes.heading: Ask right after a good job

sents.d: Asking for a review immediately after a job goes well — while the customer is still satisfied, not days later — significantly increases how many actually leave one, since the ask is a normal habit here, not an afterthought.

Responding professionally and briefly to every review, including negative ones, shows future customers how you handle problems, which matters as much as the star rating itself to someone deciding whether to hire you.
Spreading reviews across the platforms your customers actually check (commonly Google, sometimes an industry-specific site) matters more than concentrating all your effort on just one.

take: Ask for reviews right away and respond to all of them.
